title: 2 Chronicles 31: The Tithe Restored
body:
Read the chapter → [2 Chronicles 31](/bible/2-chronicles/31)

**[2 Chronicles 31:1](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v1)**

> <sup>[1](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v1)</sup> Now when all this was finished, all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah, and brake the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.

- When the feast is finished, all Israel present goes out to the cities and breaks the images, cuts down the groves, and throws down the high places and altars throughout Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh.
- Then every man returns to his own possession and city, the reformation now reaching beyond the temple into the whole land.
- This obeyed the law directly: rather than intermarry with the nations, Israel was to destroy their altars and burn their graven images.

  - **[Deuteronomy 7:3-5](/bible/deuteronomy/7#v3)**
    > <sup>[3](/bible/deuteronomy/7#v3)</sup> Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.
    >
    > <sup>[4](/bible/deuteronomy/7#v4)</sup> For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the Lord be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.
    >
    > <sup>[5](/bible/deuteronomy/7#v5)</sup> But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.

    Make no marriages with the nations, for they turn the heart to other gods; instead destroy their altars, break their images, and burn their groves.

**[2 Chronicles 31:2-8](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v2)**

> <sup>[2](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v2)</sup> And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of the Lord.
>
> <sup>[3](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v3)</sup> He appointed also the king’s portion of his substance for the burnt offerings, to wit, for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in the law of the Lord.
>
> <sup>[4](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v4)</sup> Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of the Lord.
>
> <sup>[5](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v5)</sup> And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly.
>
> <sup>[6](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v6)</sup> And concerning the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto the Lord their God, and laid them by heaps.
>
> <sup>[7](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v7)</sup> In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.
>
> <sup>[8](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v8)</sup> And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the Lord, and his people Israel.

- Hezekiah appoints the priests and Levites to their courses for burnt offerings, peace offerings, and thanksgiving, and sets the king's portion for the daily, Sabbath, new moon, and feast offerings as written in the law.
- He commands the people in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and Levites so they may be encouraged in the law, and the people bring in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, oil, honey, and the tithe of all things.
- They lay the tithe in heaps from the third to the seventh month, and when Hezekiah and the princes see the heaps they bless the Lord and his people Israel.

  - **[Deuteronomy 14:22-27](/bible/deuteronomy/14#v22)**
    > <sup>[22](/bible/deuteronomy/14#v22)</sup> Thou shalt truly tithe all the increase of thy seed, that the field bringeth forth year by year.
    >
    > <sup>[23](/bible/deuteronomy/14#v23)</sup> And thou shalt eat before the Lord thy God, in the place which he shall choose to place his name there, the tithe of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the firstlings of thy herds and of thy flocks; that thou mayest learn to fear the Lord thy God always.
    >
    > <sup>[24](/bible/deuteronomy/14#v24)</sup> And if the way be too long for thee, so that thou art not able to carry it; or if the place be too far from thee, which the Lord thy God shall choose to set his name there, when the Lord thy God hath blessed thee:
    >
    > <sup>[25](/bible/deuteronomy/14#v25)</sup> Then shalt thou turn it into money, and bind up the money in thine hand, and shalt go unto the place which the Lord thy God shall choose:
    >
    > <sup>[26](/bible/deuteronomy/14#v26)</sup> And thou shalt bestow that money for whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatsoever thy soul desireth: and thou shalt eat there before the Lord thy God, and thou shalt rejoice, thou, and thine household,
    >
    > <sup>[27](/bible/deuteronomy/14#v27)</sup> And the Levite that is within thy gates; thou shalt not forsake him; for he hath no part nor inheritance with thee.

    Truly tithe all the increase year by year, and do not forsake the Levite within your gates, for he has no part nor inheritance with you.

**[2 Chronicles 31:9-19](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v9)**

> <sup>[9](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v9)</sup> Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.
>
> <sup>[10](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v10)</sup> And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, and said, Since the people began to bring the offerings into the house of the Lord, we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for the Lord hath blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.
>
> <sup>[11](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v11)</sup> Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of the Lord; and they prepared them,
>
> <sup>[12](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v12)</sup> And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully: over which Cononiah the Levite was ruler, and Shimei his brother was the next.
>
> <sup>[13](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v13)</sup> And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.
>
> <sup>[14](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v14)</sup> And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter toward the east, was over the freewill offerings of God, to distribute the oblations of the Lord, and the most holy things.
>
> <sup>[15](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v15)</sup> And next him were Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their set office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small:
>
> <sup>[16](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v16)</sup> Beside their genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even unto every one that entereth into the house of the Lord, his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses;
>
> <sup>[17](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v17)</sup> Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their charges by their courses;
>
> <sup>[18](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v18)</sup> And to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation: for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness:
>
> <sup>[19](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v19)</sup> Also of the sons of Aaron the priests, which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities, in every several city, the men that were expressed by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites.

- Hezekiah questions the priests about the heaps, and Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answers that since the people began bringing offerings they have had enough to eat with plenty left, for the Lord has blessed his people.
- Hezekiah commands chambers prepared in the house of the Lord, and appoints faithful Levites over the offerings, tithes, and dedicated things to distribute the oblations to their brethren by courses, to great and small alike.
- The portions are given by genealogy to the priests and Levites and to their little ones, wives, sons, and daughters, for they sanctified themselves in holiness.

**[2 Chronicles 31:20-21](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v20)**

> <sup>[20](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v20)</sup> And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Judah, and wrought that which was good and right and truth before the Lord his God.
>
> <sup>[21](/bible/2-chronicles/31#v21)</sup> And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart, and prospered.

- Hezekiah does throughout all Judah that which is good and right and true before the Lord his God.
- In every work he begins in the service of the house of God, in the law, and in the commandments to seek his God, he does it with all his heart and prospers.
- This is the charge on every one of us: do the work with everything you have as unto the Lord, and keep his laws, or it will not be blessed. You cannot halfway walk in the truth and expect to grow.

  - **[Colossians 3:23](/bible/colossians/3#v23)**
    > <sup>[23](/bible/colossians/3#v23)</sup> And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

    Whatsoever ye do, do it heartily as to the Lord and not unto men.
  - **[1 Kings 2:2-3](/bible/1-kings/2#v2)**
    > <sup>[2](/bible/1-kings/2#v2)</sup> I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;
    >
    > <sup>[3](/bible/1-kings/2#v3)</sup> And keep the charge of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:

    Be strong, show thyself a man, and keep the charge of the Lord to walk in his ways, that thou mayest prosper in all thou doest.
